g.text: Merge flow of the counter conflict (plan revision M-1, decision 31)
Lane 1: two branches use one queue
branch A, one deploy: enqueue x
branch B, one deploy: dequeue or peek
event log index of each branch:
a COMM without peeks files its produces
is not persistent, and a Reified channel
race: the merge rejects one branch,
so no merged queue holds two records with one ord
Lane 2: two deploys of one block
the block index puts d1 and d2 into one chain:
a rejection removes both deploys together
Lane 3: two branches use two open queues
branch A: operations on queue q1
consume the counter produce of q1
branch B: operations on queue q2
consume the counter produce of q2
no shared consumed produce, no new consume
beside a new produce, no join of two channels
which equals a serial run of the branches
stored state: the counter record, the merged queues
space operation of a deploy, with its counter bump
merger and block index of the baseline, unchanged
